posts.title: A Troll, a Gold Mining Town and a Sunset
posts.description: A bit cool today when the sun was not out but still a pretty good day. Martha and I drove the Honda CRV down Colorado highway 67 towards the town of Victor, Colorado. Back during the Gold Rush days, this town was a booming area with gold miners trying their luck in the nearby hills. But we were looking for a troll named Rita.
